options.content: Confirmation requires matching GitOps and running digests, a complete healthy rollout and Argo CD Synced/Healthy. Choose Kubernetes Loki to load the observations.

targets.expr: (last_over_time({job="kubernetes-pods",namespace="monitoring",container="lantern-kpi-collector"} |= "LANTERN_KPI " | regexp `LANTERN_KPI (?P<payload>\{.*\})$` | line_format "{{.payload}}" | json kpi_kind="kind", kpi_value="value", service_id, repository, squad, snapshot, status | kpi_kind="delivery_assessment_info" | service_id=~"${service:regex}" | unwrap kpi_value | __error__="" [15m]) by (service_id, snapshot, status)) and on (service_id, snapshot) topk by (service_id) (1, max_over_time({job="kubernetes-pods",namespace="monitoring",container="lantern-kpi-collector"} |= "LANTERN_KPI " | regexp `LANTERN_KPI (?P<payload>\{.*\})$` | line_format "{{.payload}}" | json kpi_kind="kind", kpi_value="value", service_id, repository, squad, snapshot | kpi_kind="collector_snapshot" | service_id=~"${service:regex}" | unwrap kpi_value | __error__="" [15m]) by (service_id, snapshot))
